source: Tŷ Mawr reference photographs (4 Nov 2026: aerial from SE, house front, stables from the yard) and reference paintings + colourised historic aerial (5 Nov 2026: barn with stable range; house, forecourt and gate; aerial of the group). Layout corrected 5 Nov 2026 to the Executive's written corrections, which win over any reading of the images: house front faces south; stable range faces south with its front level with the house front (never further forward); the barn on the west side of the group faces west. Sizes scaled from the images, best guess.
